recorded_playthrough.source: Exported Godot app Movie Maker output; scripts/record_route.sh converts the original AVI with ffmpeg.
recorded_playthrough.capture_mode: Godot Movie Maker at fixed 60 fps; engine.log explicitly confirms this. Not real-time performance evidence.
recorded_playthrough.review: Opening, flight, arrival and completion PNGs from the recording inspected. Root additionally inspected encoded frames at 32.0 s and 33.5 s; verification.json records those checks. Movie metadata verified with ffprobe; uninterrupted human viewing not claimed.
recorded_playthrough.report_limitation: Movie/fixed-step mode metadata was explicitly corrected after capture using scripts/record_route.sh, engine.log and ffprobe. Original false argument detection remains in recording_context. Movie timing is not real-time performance evidence.

verification.full_decode: Passed; ffmpeg exit 0 and no decoder errors
verification.limitation: Technical decode and signal verification do not establish subjective viewing or audition quality.

native_performance_evidence.limitation: Foreground requested, but every sampled focus value is false. This is measured native automated cadence, not verified human foreground play. Engine timing is not OS CPU utilization or power measurement.
